title: Robert Maxwell PROMIS software sold to national labs

tellings.quote: this sort of promise software. Are you familiar with this that Robert Maxwell, you know, who obviously is intimately connected with Epstein, sold to our national labs

plain: Michels says Robert Maxwell, the British publisher he calls closely connected with Jeffrey Epstein, sold a program called PROMIS, case-tracking software, to the US national laboratories. He raises it himself as a question to Bill Richardson, a former Secretary of Energy, asking if he knew of it; if true, it would mean a man with those ties had software inside America's weapons labs.
